**Eligibility rules (from README.md):**

|---|---|---|---|

| R1002 | complete | yes | $5.00 |
| R1003 | incomplete | no | $0.00 |

| R1005 | complete | yes | $5.00 |
| R1006 | complete | yes | $5.00 |
| R1007 | incomplete | no | $0.00 |
| R1008 | **disqualified** | no | $0.00 (speeder) |
| R1009 | complete | yes | $5.00 |
| R1010 | **disqualified** | no | $0.00 (flatline) |

**Total payout: $25.00** (5 eligible respondents × $5.00 USD each). The 3 disqualified respondents (R1004, R1008, R1010) are flagged in the `notes` column so the panel vendor can be notified to replace their data.
